official_definition: Love Me Zone - (When Attacks/Blocks) "Kamishiro Karen"/"Asuka Mirai" cards you control are unaffected by opposing effects. Also, once per turn, you can refresh an "Asuka Mirai" you control.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Love Me Zone] or [Love Me Zone: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Love Me Zone]", "give [Love Me Zone]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Transitions state from EXHAUSTED to REFRESHED.
